complete_saved_blocks.complete_text: Iori's central tension is the relationship between competent intervention and the boundary that makes an intervention protective. She can intercept, pursue, inspect, ask for command, accept practical assistance and recognize a good result. She can also make a premature accusation, fail to notice a trap, threaten disproportionate force under the name of official work and become caught in comic or coercive situations she did not choose. Those are competing facts about the same represented repertoire. A reading that makes her either an infallible professional or an exclusively foolish victim removes the tension that gives her decisions significance.

She wants warmth from a cherished blanket while refusing the adult's interest in its scent. She calls for rescue from a pit and separately requires photographs to be deleted. Each invitation names an object and purpose. Practical success can be real without answering a different claim over her body, property or privacy. Rescue does not retroactively make a photograph welcome; gratitude for a bandage does not make every future contact authorized. [Private family, source004/005/007/009/010/013/015/021.]
